ANALYSIS ENGINE

Connect TopologicPy

Run the included Python service locally, or connect a hosted instance. Your floor plans are sent only to the service you choose.

Hosted workspace connections need an HTTPS service. Local HTTP works when you open the app from the local service.
A QUICK START

From plan to insight.

  1. Connect your engine. Start the companion service and connect its address. The bundled gallery floor plan loads in meters, ready for analysis.
  2. Import a plan. Use closed planar boundaries or connected linework. Choose the face you want to analyze. All formats are imported through TopologicPy. IFC buildings include walkable slab surfaces, stairs, ramps and lifts.
  3. Choose a measure. Visibility analysis samples the navigable area. Angular metrics operate on the imported segment network. Isovists can be computed as a field or at a clicked viewpoint.
  4. Explore the map. Change palettes and color limits without recomputing. Hover or tap to inspect the original value. Turn on the underlying graph to inspect connections.
  5. Take your results. Export the computed values, geometry, graph, parameters, and current colors as CSV, a PNG image, or JSON.

IFC geometry uses metres. Isovists stay horizontal, 1.6 m above each floor elevation. Open floor voids allow sightlines across them; walls and columns block visibility. Neither voids nor obstacles can be chosen as viewpoints or walked across. Incomplete connectors remain disconnected. Grid analyses support up to 10,000 points. Larger analyses may take longer.
